messages:
hana: FYI alert from synthetic checks: increased 5xx rate for /v1/re-rank in dedicated-us-central starting ~15:02 UTC. Customers hitting higher latency and some error responses.
matt: I'm looking at the model-serving logs. A subset of replicas are returning "ModelShardUnavailable" after the recent shard placement change.
ivan: Paging infra oncall. @oncall-bot open incident please.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-5899 created and routed to infra-oncall. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-5899
matt: Short-term mitigation: pin routing to previous shard mapping by setting routing.policy.override=previous_map for us-central. Applying now.
hana: Command applied. Traffic shifted away from problematic replicas; error rate dropped from 8% -> 0.9% within 90s.
ivan: We're also rolling a hotfix to the shard allocator to avoid assigning >N hot shards per host. Patch review in progress.
cs-team: Notifying affected customers and opening high-priority support queues.
status-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/PD-5899 - "Partial degradation: reranker shard placement issue in US-CENTRAL; mitigation in progress"
matt: Hotfix merged and deployed to us-central canary. Observing canary for 10m then promote.
matt: Canary looks healthy; promoting. Deployment command: kubectl rollout restart statefulset/reranker -n prod
ivan: Follow-ups: 1) add placement heuristics test to e2e to prevent hot-shard skew 2) add alert when shard-unavailable >1% 3) improve placement rollback automation
hana: Filing tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8220 , INF-8221, INF-8222
oncall-bot: Incident PD-5899 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring
hana: Thanks all. Postmortem draft ETA 2h; will include customer impact summary and timeline.
